_comment: The three example afflictions printed on page 232, transcribed. Nothing here is interpreted: the effect strings are the book's, and the conditions array beside each is the same sentence in the form the system applies. verify-afflictions holds the two against each other.

afflictions.name: Filth Fever
afflictions.description: This awful disease is spread by the bite of rats and other rodents.

afflictions.name: Blinding Sickness
afflictions.description: This nasty disease infects a target over a period of time slowly causes them to lose their sight.

afflictions.name: Lycanthropy
afflictions.description: Lycanthropy is a transformative condition that grants individuals both animalistic powers and uncontrollable urges, often seen as a blessing and a curse by various cultures.

stages.effect: The target becomes a were-creature appropriate to the one that was responsible for infecting them.
